question: 20% of the inhabitants of a village having died of malaria, a panic set in, during which 30% of the remaining inhabitants left the village. The population was then reduced to 12,000. What was the number of inhabitants initially (Consider integral part only)
solution:
**Given:**

20% of the inhabitants of the village died of malaria

30% of the inhabitants left the village

**Formula used:**

Inhabitants reduced = Population × (100 - Decreased %) 

**Calculation:**

According to the formula, 

The inhabitants initially, 

⇒ Reduced = P × (100 - 20%) × (100 - 30%)

&l
t;p>⇒ 12000 = P×(70)/(100)×(80)/(100)

⇒ P = frac{12000×100×100} {70×80} 

⇒ P = 21428

**⇒ Hence, The population initially was 21428**
